message:
The other day, I was preparing for what was supposed to be a big storm. I had my flashlight, snacks, and a cozy blanket all set up for a cozy evening. But wouldn’t you know it? Just as the wind started howling, my phone decided to join the dramatic show by dying completely. 

I realized then that while it's great to have tech at our fingertips, sometimes it’s the good old-fashioned pen and paper that come to the rescue. I quickly jotted down a few important numbers and reminders—because I certainly didn’t want to be caught without my neighbor’s number if I needed to borrow their casserole dish during the storm! 

So, if you’re planning for the next weather event, maybe consider keeping a little notepad handy, just in case. What’s your favorite low-tech tip for staying prepared?
